posts.title: Driving Up 3.4% from 2019, .5% from 2025
posts.description: Despite high fuel prices, Americans drove 3.4 percent more miles in September of 2026 than the same month in 2019. They even drove 0.5 percent more miles than in September 2025, according to data released yesterday by the Federal Highway Administration. posts.title: The City of Cronyism
posts.description: The city of Portland (population 652,500) survived for more than 170 years without having a city manager. Instead, each of the agencies in the city government were overseen by different members of the five-members city council.
